name: released
description: A kind that keeps its released rows in a table of its own: a root's first release writes the released tree's rows of the kind, each with the release's commit and sequence; a later release writes the rows that differ from the tree released before and removes the ones it lost, and leaves the others as an earlier release wrote them; a rollback is a release too; a release of the commit already released rewrites every row, which restores one removed by hand; a release refused for its version, or for an untagged commit, writes nothing; another root's rows, and a kind that keeps no released table, are untouched.

statement.postgres: SELECT heading FROM part_released WHERE recipe_id = $1::uuid
statement.sqlite: SELECT json_extract(data, '$.heading') AS heading FROM graph_released WHERE kind = 'part' AND root_id = ?1

statement.postgres: SELECT heading, rank, CASE WHEN parent_key IS NULL THEN 'none' ELSE 'some' END AS parent, sequence::text AS sequence, CASE commit_id WHEN $2::uuid THEN 'v1' ELSE 'other' END AS commit FROM part_released WHERE recipe_id = $1::uuid ORDER BY heading
statement.sqlite: SELECT json_extract(data, '$.heading') AS heading, json_extract(data, '$.rank') AS rank, CASE WHEN json_extract(data, '$.parent_key') IS NULL THEN 'none' ELSE 'some' END AS parent, CAST(sequence AS TEXT) AS sequence, CASE commit_id WHEN ?2 THEN 'v1' ELSE 'other' END AS "commit" FROM graph_released WHERE kind = 'part' AND root_id = ?1 ORDER BY 1

statement.postgres: SELECT heading, sequence::text AS sequence FROM part_released WHERE recipe_id = $1::uuid ORDER BY heading
statement.sqlite: SELECT json_extract(data, '$.heading') AS heading, CAST(sequence AS TEXT) AS sequence FROM graph_released WHERE kind = 'part' AND root_id = ?1 ORDER BY 1

statement.postgres: DELETE FROM part_released WHERE recipe_id = $1::uuid AND heading = 'Mix'
statement.sqlite: DELETE FROM graph_released WHERE kind = 'part' AND root_id = ?1 AND json_extract(data, '$.heading') = 'Mix'

statement.postgres: UPDATE part_released SET heading = 'Scribbled' WHERE recipe_id = $1::uuid AND heading = 'Knead'
statement.sqlite: UPDATE graph_released SET data = '{"heading":"Scribbled","parent_key":null,"rank":"V"}' WHERE kind = 'part' AND root_id = ?1 AND json_extract(data, '$.heading') = 'Knead'

statement.sqlite: SELECT CAST(count(*) AS TEXT) AS rows FROM graph_released
